notes.title: 'Bru & Boegie: Episode 2 - Get da SUGAR!' Announced, and more!
notes.content:
[h2][b]'Bru & Boegie: EPISODE 2 - Get da SUGAR!' Announced![/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615488/101a44e2cc46d13c494887cf578dcc4300104583.png"][/img][/p][p]Welcome, friends! Some exciting [b]Bru & Boegie[/b] news in this post![/p][p][b]Episode 2 has been announced! [/b]Ha cha cha cha. W[b]e[/b] pick things up directly after the events of [b]Episode 1[/b]. It's now... time to '[b]Get da SUGAR![/b]'. Ma boi Bru gotta get a coffee somehow. I've completed much of the story outlining and plan to start production on it once I'm done with Episode 1's launch preps.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615488/fe602180835d943a1b1946e0602264a86b18f8af.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Episode 2[/b] is shaping up to be roughly [b]twice the length of Episode 1[/b], also featuring a [b]fully-voiced cast[/b] and [b]original soundtrack[/b], with even more [b]bizarre characters, environments[/b] and [b]puzzles[/b] - overall, more of the good stuff. I have plans for the Episode 3 finale too, but one thing at a time.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615488/ae0029b79f9fe8459fbd58c54ede0974c53d4521.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Episode 2[/b] is available to [b]Wishlist[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615488/034388e610f9ffd9af9eb4517eba795c1d06464a.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Bru & Boegie: Episode 1 - Demo Incoming[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615488/d6b4498d38ab064658b1f39c92f93b69f86d6611.png"][/img][/p][p]
The freely downloadable [b]Episode 1 Steam demo[/b] will be launching in a couple of weeks. I plan to submit the demo for [i]Steam’s NextFest[/i] that happens in October, where the eyeballs of an entirely new audience will be exposed to Bru’s extremely bright tighty whities, intended to dazzle and amaze. I plan to launch the full game shortly afterwards.[/p][p]The Steam version features[b] improved audio treatment and balancing[/b], [b]re-processed voices[/b] and some [b]new environmental audio effects[/b]. There’s also [b]14 Steam Achievements[/b] and also [b]Steam Cloud Saves[/b], so players should be able to sync saves across devices, and play the demo and continue their progress in the full game. I'm planning to add a couple more[b] options[/b] too. The[b] Steam version[/b] will be [b]by far the best way to experience the game[/b].[/p][p]I plan to launch the free public Steam [b]demo next month[/b] in August, and then the [b]full game on October 29 [/b]this year. [/p][p][b]Episode 1[/b] is available to [b]Wishlist[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615488/1a2ce4e2516a75063192010ca8ab97ad3bc2aff8.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Bru & Boegie 2025 MEGA UPDATE Video[/b][/h2][previewyoutube="UMkouckk5XQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]I recently posted a [b]video[/b] detailing[b] all my videogame and animation Bru & Boegie [/b]updates, including my 10-min animated Bru & Boegie short ‘[b]METEORITE[/b]’ that I completed animation on a couple of weeks ago. I decided this year to focus on my own projects, so I’ve [i]ONLY[/i] been doing Bru & Boegie work - it’s been fantastic, all-consuming, and there’s always more to do.[/p][p]In the video above, I share some of my process for designing the backgrounds for Episode 2:[/p][p]Also, after the game launched on itch.io I wrote a post-launch blog on my website with further thoughts and insights:[/p][p][url="https://www.mikdog.com/bru-boegie-get-da-milk-post-launch/"]https://www.mikdog.com/bru-boegie-get-da-milk-post-launch/[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]That about wraps it up for now. Please don’t forget to[b] Wishlist Episode 1 and 2[/b], and thank you for your continued interest in [i]Bru & Boegie[/i] - it means the world to me. ❤️[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615488/1a2ce4e2516a75063192010ca8ab97ad3bc2aff8.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615488/034388e610f9ffd9af9eb4517eba795c1d06464a.png"][/img][/p]
